before_every_vm_create: read-only: gcloud compute project-info describe -> assert GPUS_ALL_REGIONS usage == 0, else STOP and tell the user
read-only: gcloud compute instances list -> assert no RUNNING VM with accelerators
preflight.blocker_2026_10_07: GPUS_ALL_REGIONS limit 1, usage 1 (read 19:11 UTC): socreateai-agora-hermes-node1 (us-east4-b, T4, SPOT) is RUNNING. Not a GwenLaya VM: the user stops it or schedules around it; never stopped autonomously.
preflight.between_stages: delete every purpose=gwenlaya VM and its disk at the end of each stage (weights live in GCS); a TERMINATED VM frees the GPU quota but its disk still bills
preflight.cloud_run_before_s7: read-only: gcloud beta quotas info list --service=run.googleapis.com; first deploy must report the quota; if no L4 quota, S7 is dropped and the user told; never request quota

spend_rules: a stage's cap covers its whole VM lifecycle: boot, downloads, re-downloads after preemption, idle
--max-run-duration = remaining stage cap / planning rate; at the cap the stage stops and is reported PARTIAL, never extended silently
accrued cost is checked against the cap at every stage boundary and by an in-stage watchdog every 30 min
checkpoints / generation caches are committed to GCS every <= 15 min; resume from the last COMMITTED object

generation_settings.thinking: disabled for every tier, domain and stage (chat template enable_thinking=false / Ollama think=false)
generation_settings.eval_decoding: greedy (temperature 0) except B4 samples and S3 rejection sampling
generation_settings.engine: llama.cpp server, --parallel 8 continuous batching, same build for all GGUF quants
generation_settings.gpu_seconds_attribution: batch wall-time split by each call's share of generated+prompt tokens in that batch
generation_settings.reuse_rule: each (tier, quant, item, seed) is generated once and cached; GL, SH, LR, B-arms and the 2x2 replay the cache; no arm regenerates
generation_settings.verification_location: never on the GPU VM: all gate and scoring checks run on the local CPU (C3, C6, C7) against cached candidates
